tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so/ /༈/bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de/ /lam 'bras gsung mdo bri bar bya/ /sems can la/nyon mongs pa la/
༄༅/ /rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so/ /༈/bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de/ /lam 'bras gsung mdo bri bar bya/ /sems can la/nyon mongs pa la/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de// lam 'bras gsung mdo bri bar bya// sems can la/ nyon mongs pa la/ ma dag pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa la/ ting nge 'dzin la/ nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa la/ sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la/ dag pa'i snang ba'o// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud/ lus thabs rgyud sogs la gdan sogs sogs gsum pa bzhis rgyu'i dbang*/ lam du bskyed rim sogs lnga pa bzhis bstan/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig sogs bsrung*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis nyams chag bskang*/ 'dod yon sogs lngas mnyes pa sogs bya/ lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgoms pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag cing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas bshad rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni 'bras bu'i dbang bzhis thams cad mkhyen to// tshad ma bzhis 'bras bu gtan la phab nas/ 'gal 'dus skyon med sogs gsum gyis bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/ zas/ spyod lam/ rlung*/ thig le/ phyag rgya ma bsten/ dwangs ma lnga'i bde ba dang*/ dbang po lnga nyams dang ma bral bas bdud rtsi bsten/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo rnams dang*/ gzhan rnams dang*/ sa thog mtha' la re re/ gsum pa bcus bar gyi rtsa bdud bral bas la dor/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog bsgoms pas lta ba'i dug dbyung*/ rnam shes lngas yul lnga ma spangs pas bdud rtsi bsten/ dag pa'i chos rnams gdod nas stong par shar bas la dor/ gsang sngags snyan brgyud sogs bzhi ma chad pa/ lus khyad par can la brten nas dngos po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba/ gzhan dbang rten 'brel/ byang chub chen po'i lam/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lo rgyus kyi tshad ma/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag pa'i byang chub chen po/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lngas lam yongs su rdzogs pa'o// thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi bar chad ni/

dad pa brtan pos bsrung*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo/ sngags zlos/ sngags mdud/ chos rnams sems nyid snang ba/ gzhan dbang rten 'brel/ gzugs brnyan yin phyir de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i don dang ma bral bas bsrung*/ shes rab la phyi'i bdud la lam gnyis/ lta grub brgyad bsgyur ba 'ong*/ nang lam sogs bcu dang brda ma shes na 'ong*/ shes pas bsrung*/ grib dang sgrib pa thig le 'dzag pa bsrung*// //tshogs lam nas tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid dang bral ba'i 'bras bu bzhi thob nas/ khams 'du lugs gsum gyi phyogs med rnams dang*/ rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs nas/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun ltar lam bgrod na/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ las kyi rlung*/ pho/ mo/ ma ning gi rlung*/ thod rgal ye shes kyi me 'bar bas khams 'dus pa dang po dgun gyi rlung po lag cha can gyis rtsa dral/ sems gnas/ rta rmi/ rtsa rlung gi zug 'byung*/ rtsa sna tshogs mdud sogs/ gzhi rtsa ba'i rlung sogs bcu/ zin pa'i bye brag bdun gyis yan lag gi rlung rim gyis nang du 'gag thig le mang du kha 'bu/ rten mnyam du 'dres/ de la brten nas sems nang du gnas/ rnam shes lnga nang du 'dus/ phung po lnga dul/ ye shes kyi 'gro ldog byed/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i mthong snang*/ rmi lam/ nyams gsum gsum ni rnam rtog sngon du song ba ltar khams gsum kun tu snang ngo*// sa chu la thim na smig rgyu/ chu me la thim na du ba/ me rlung la thim na srin bu me khyer/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim na mar me 'bar ba/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim na nam mkha' sprin med lta bu/ sa chu me rlung dang rlungs sems mnyam par 'dus na khams gsum kun tu me lta bur snang ngo*// chu rlung dang spu lus grang*/ rlung gi rlung 'du 'phro dang*/ rang 'phur/ bya 'byung*/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang*/

lha mo sna tshogs kyis gar mchod/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung sna tshogs dang dri ro/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang spu lus bde/ bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin gshegs sku sogs/ sihla dang nyi ma/ ga pur dang zla ba/ rtsa phran rnams su thig phran dang skar ma/ rtsa 'dzin sogs su shing sdong sogs/ chags sdang rnam pa lnga dang*/ nyam nga*/ mya ngan/ 'dre'i rtsa/ mchi ma'i rtsar g.yal dang mchi ma/ lte bar dang po chags pa'i rigs drug gi yi ger rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na/ rigs drug gi gar/ sngags/ der khrid pa/ rmi lam/ nyams lta bur khams gsum kun tu snang ngo*// oṃ las bsam gtan sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin/ yum gyi mkha' āḥl yang dag par thim na khams gsum nam mkha'/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyi ma sogs kyi pho brang du thim na chos sku nyams su myong zhing gzung 'dzin grol/ hūm̐ las gsal zhing yang la rang byung gi ye shes nam mkha' shin tu dri ma med/ khams 'dus pa bar pa rlung po lag cha bri bas rtsa dral/ thig le'i zug dang mthong snang brtan no// mdor na rakṣa sogs su srin po sogs/ dril can gyi sgra/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pa bzhin/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams su 'byung ba snyam byed pa bshad kyis mi lang ba mtshon cing*/ lnga bcu la gsang*/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i phyi'i rten 'brel rlung log sogs gsum gsum ni/ nang gi mkha' 'gro lnga/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lnga byang chub chen po'i rten 'brel mdzad pas/ dngos grub rnams rang las 'byung bar shes shing*/ shes pas re zhing rtsol ba'i blo sel to// bdud dang gol sa rnams rang gi lam dang rten 'brel du shes pas skyon yon tan du bslang zhing*/ rim pa yin min du skye ba'i drod byung rgyal du gtang ngo*// shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i lam la lha'i bu'i bdud 'ong bas sad pa bzhis bsrung*/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni/

yul 'gags pas rang yi dam gyi lha dang gug skyed kyi dgos pa bsam zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam pas khams 'dus pa tha ma rlung po lag cha bral bas rtsa dral/ skye mched drug gi nang du thig le 'dus pas rjes su dran pa drug yang dag par shes/ sprul sku 'ga' mthong*/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i yang dag par spong ba bzhi ni/ sprul sku las dbang gsum gyi rjes la 'byung ba'i shes pa bsam zhing*/ dgyes sogs pad can bcu gnyis ma'i rtsa btsal zhing*/ snying po'i a kun 'dar gyi sna rtser dal rgyu sogs rigs pas yid 'jug pas/ lus ngag yid rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ thig les rlung non pas rnga sgra sogs mi thos pas/ chog shes pa sogs kyi bdud choms pas so// nang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam srid pa'i rtse mor phyin cing*/ ma skyes pa'i chos la bzod par dka' ba stong pa nyid kyi bzod pa/ dbu mar sems rtog med log sems 'phos na bzod pa/ 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pas chos rnams kyi nang na mchog go /de ltar nyams skyon can dang*/ skyon med dang*/ phyi dbyibs kyi a na yar rlung sems mnyam par 'dus nas/ lam du 'byung ba rnams/ ngo bo/ rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid do// //'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ phyi nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lam gyis sprul sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub 'thob par byed pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam nas/ lus 'dag par byed pa bum pa'i dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rtsa rin po che'i pho brang bzhi/ gtso mo gsum ste lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas/ rtogs pa'i 'gro ldog byed/ sprul sku'i zhing khams brgya bsgul zhing*/ nyan/ sbyin brgya/ 'od brgya 'gyed/ mar brgya 'chad/ ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba brgya la snyoms par 'jug nus/ rigs drug gi rtsar khyad par du mi'i rten mthong na/

dga' la g.yang za/ ngo tsha la skyug bro/ sngon bla mas rgyu dus na bstan pa'i 'khor 'das dbyer med de tsam na rtogs/ snying rje skye/ mchi ma ltung*/ gzhan gyi sems sna tshogs shes/ 'dod yon sna tshogs mthong bas dgod bro/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs skad cig mas 'byung ba rnams nang gi zhing khams mthong bas so// nang ma mthong bar phyi mi mthong*/ de tsam na liṅga brtan/ rdo rje'i rtser lhan cig skyes pa'i sar thig le gnas pa ltar lus bde bas myos shing brgyal/ rang gzhan ngo mi shes/ nang rtags rlung sor gcig 'gag phyi rtags gsang gnas phyed thig les brtan/ mthong lam sa dang po'o// //yang sprul sku las dbang bzhi bzhi/ sgom lam sa gnyis nas sprul sku'i zhing khams stong la sogs pa sgul ba la sogs pa nus/ yon tan sogs 'phel/ 'gro ldog sogs 'gag nang rtags rlung sor drug 'gag phyi rtags gsang gnas lte snying thig les brtan/ longs sku 'ga' mthong*/ sgom lam sa drug pa'o// //yang longs sku las dbang bzhi bzhi/ bdag byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa'i lam nas longs sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub 'thob par byed pa/ ngag 'dag par byed pa gsang ba'i dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags dbang po lnga dang*/ dwangs ma lnga'i rlung la mnga' brnyes/ nus pa lnga dang*/ lta stangs rnams la thogs pa med/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du rigs drug gi sa bon mthong*/ sa bon drug la mnga' brnyes/ sems can rnams kyi skad du chos ston cing*/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la thogs pa med/ lte bar yi ge'i phyi mo brgyad ā li kā lir mthong nas/ mdo sde'i chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la thogs pa med/ bdud rtsi lnga dang ro drug la longs spyod nus/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs su gyur pa rnams a ni yig 'bru zhes sogs drug gis gsal lo// sa bdun pa yan chad 'khor bzhi'i rgya longs sku'i zhing khams dung phyur la sogs pa sgul ba la sogs pa nus/

nang rtags rlung sor bcu 'gag phyi rtags mgrin smin thig les brtan/ sgom lam sa bcu pa'o// //yang chos sku las dbang bzhi bzhi/ sems 'dag par byed pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs kyi lam nas chos sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub 'thob par byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags stobs lnga dang byang chub kyi sems kyi rlung lnga spyod pa'i dwangs ma'i dwangs ma rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas rtags bstan pa/ sku gsum ye shes lnga sogs dbang thob nas/ bdud rtsi lnga rtsa gar 'du ba mthong na/ sangs rgyas rnams gzhan don mdzad pa mthong*/ sprul pa bde chen du thig le 'du ba mthong na/ sangs rgyas rnams 'og min gyi gnas na zab mo la bzhugs pa mthong*/ lte ba sprul par bdud rtsi lnga dang rlung lnga 'du ba mthong na/ longs sku rigs lnga yum gyi bha ga na gzhug nas skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' la gsang ba sgrogs pa mthong*/ phyag rgya ma'i dwangs ma'i dwangs ma mthong na mngon shes la thogs pa med/ rtsa yig rnams su dwangs ma 'drongs na rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med/ de nyid slar spos na sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu gnyis 'gag phyi rtags spyi gtsug hril thig les brtan/ sgom lam sa bcu gnyis pa'o// //yang dbang bzhi bzhi/ mthar phyin gyi lam nas/ mthar thug rten 'brel gyis mthar thug 'dag par byed pa/ rdo rje rba rlabs kyi lam nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub/ rig ma'i skyes bu srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub 'thob par byed pa/ bzhi pa lus ngag yid kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ni/ rnam shes brgyad 'dag kar 'bras bu gnyis thob ste/ sa chen 'di ni dga' zhing rangs la mgu/ de rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ bdud gnas su sgra grag

phyag rgya ma'i gnas su khams gsum mthong*/ mkha' 'gro rnams ring nas 'du/ ha ri ma la sogs pa dbang phyug gi don brgyad 'char/ nang rtags srog rtsol a ba dhū tīr 'jug phyi rtags gtsug tor phyed thig les brtan/ sa phyed dang bcu gsum pa'o// //bzhi pa yid kyi dbang mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu gcig thob ste/ 'bigs byed gzhon nu'i grong khyer chos kyi dbyings byang chub sems kyis ni 'bigs/ 'bras bu chos sku'i zhing khams rab bkram la sogs pa sgul ba la sogs pa nus/ sa bcu gsum thob kar sa bcu ma la sogs pa yid kyis bkug ste/ slob dpon dus gsum bder gshegs bcud 'dus yin/ yi dam lha dang bla ma dbyer med las bha gar dngos grub len pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag pa rang bzhin gyis lhun grub 'thob par byed pa 'bras bu mthar phyin/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i zhing khams ma lus pa la sogs pa sgul ba la sogs pa nus/ nang rtags srog rtsol a ba dhū tīr 'gag phyi rtags gtsug tor hril thig les brtan/ phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyis sgom nyams skyon yod med phyed pas/ sa bcu gsum pa'o// thams cad mkhyen to// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin sar rten 'brel 'grigs pa ltar snang*/ 'tshang rgya kar 'khor tshom bu gcig dang bcas te 'tshang rgya/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni// rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i dbang*// rtog pas brtags kyang rtog med rtogs// ye shes snang ba de bzhin no// lam zab bla ma/ dam tshig lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dang man ngag tu bcas pa rdzogs so// //sa māpta mi thī// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
